mentions.name: Puma Browser
mentions.description: An open-source text-based web browser for the terminal, emphasizing privacy and speed. It is native and small, private by default, terminal-safe, and configurable, and is agent-ready via a built-in MCP server exposing read-only tools (browser_open, browser_read, browser_list_links). Still pre-1.0 and in daily use, with new features added weekly.
mentions.problem: Terminal users who want to browse the web are disappointed with existing options like Lynx.
mentions.audience: Terminal users who love working in the terminal but are disappointed with Lynx.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building a new modern Terminal browser. A text based browser for the terminal. Full privacy, features. Ultra fast. For those who love to work in terminal but somehow are dissapointed with Lynx.

* Native and small.
* Private by default.
* Terminal-safe.
* Agent-ready. A built-in MCP server exposes read-only tools (browser_open, browser_read, browser_list_links).
* Configurable.
mentions.author: meerita
